integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone checker are supplied; experimental checks are not substituted for an infinite proof. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Four i.i.d. arclength-uniform unit-circle points; not area-uniform points or nonuniform boundary sampling. No novelty claimed for the crossing-angle marginal or unconditional maximal-area tail. Conditional CDF is represented by an exact one-dimensional integral. Historical priority provisional.
title: Conditional area law for random cyclic quadrilaterals at a fixed diagonal angle
